summary: On node1, IPv4 ICMP-redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance are now persistently disabled via /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf (accept_redirects and accept_source_route set to 0 for both 'all' and 'default'). Baseline was accept_redirects=1 (all/default) and accept_source_route default=1. Change was applied live with sysctl --system, then node1 was restarted (boot_id changed from 37344ae4-6582-4c1f-ac5c-fcb32f67b968 to d5be2f6d-874b-4cd1-8df5-5caeea968a55, confirming an actual reboot, not just a service restart), and post-reboot verification confirms all four sysctl values remain 0 and the config file persisted.
actions_performed: Captured baseline sysctl values for accept_redirects and accept_source_route (all/default) on node1
Inspected existing /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf files to avoid conflicting entries
Applied config live with 'sysctl --system' and verified runtime values changed to 0
Verified 'all' setting uses AND-logic with per-interface values in the kernel, so effective acceptance is disabled network-wide despite legacy per-interface values on enp1s0/lo
Triggered a backgrounded 'reboot' with a delayed sleep so the exec acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Confirmed node went unreachable during the in-flight reboot, then polled until it came back
Verified boot_id changed post-restart, confirming a genuine reboot occurred
Re-verified sysctl values and the persistent config file remained correct after reboot

evidence.requirement: Baseline state of ICMP redirect / source-route acceptance before change
evidence.summary: Showed accept_redirects=1 (all/default) and accept_source_route: all=0, default=1 prior to hardening.

evidence.requirement: No conflicting pre-existing persistent config for these settings
evidence.summary: Confirmed existing sysctl.d files (e.g. 10-network-security.conf) and sysctl.conf had these directives commented out or unrelated, so the new file would take effect without conflict.

evidence.requirement: Persistent disabling of ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance for IPv4
evidence.summary: Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf, applied via 'sysctl --system', and verified live values net.ipv4.conf.all/default.accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0 immediately after.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline (boot identity) before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=37344ae4-6582-4c1f-ac5c-fcb32f67b968 and uptime baseline prior to reboot.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded delayed reboot command returned pid acknowledgement immediately, before the node disconnected.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node actually restarted (unreachable during reboot)
evidence.summary: Immediately following exec call timed out, confirming the node was down mid-reboot.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: changed boot identity proving genuine restart
evidence.summary: Post-recovery boot_id=d5be2f6d-874b-4cd1-8df5-5caeea968a55, differing from baseline, proving a real reboot occurred (not just a service bounce).

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: required configuration persisted and recovered after restart
evidence.summary: Post-reboot check shows sysctl values still 0 for accept_redirects/accept_source_route (all/default) and the persistent config file /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf intact with correct contents.
